text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"You are approximately 155 meters away from a large toxic anhydrous ammonia release point.","main_move":"STAY_IN_SEAL","main_move_text":"Shelter indoors immediately, seal all windows and doors, and turn off ventilation systems.","where_to_go":"Stay inside the institution building, Nehru Nagar, 155 meters northeast of the release point.","do_now":[{"text":"Close all doors and windows and seal gaps with wet cloths or tape.","advice_ids":["ADV_SHELTER_SEAL"]},{"text":"Turn off all air conditioning, heating, and ventilation systems immediately.","advice_ids":["ADV_DISABLE_HVAC"]},{"text":"Cover your mouth and nose with a damp cloth to protect against ammonia fumes.","advice_ids":["ADV_PROTECT_RESPIRATORY"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not go outside or venture into low-lying outdoor areas.","advice_ids":["ADV_AVOID_OUTDOORS"]},{"text":"Do not turn on exhaust fans or air handling units.","advice_ids":["ADV_NO_VENTILATION"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"In a school, hospital or other institution","text":"Keep all occupants inside, shut down central air units, and coordinate with institution emergency wardens.","advice_ids":["ADV_INSTITUTION_ACTION"]}],"call":["112","101","108"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Exact location coordinates and wind vector allow clear proximity and plume assessment.","unknowns":["Building air-tightness level","Central HVAC shutoff capability"],"valid_while":["Until emergency personnel give official evacuation orders or all-clear."]}
